business.name: Best Western Plus St. Christopher Hotel

ranking.name: Best Western Plus St. Christopher Hotel

text.text_excerpt: We enjoyed our stay here during a recent trip to New Orleans for the Jazz Festival. The location of this hotel was the best -- just cross Canal and you're on Decatur Street of the French Quarter (plus Harrah's Casino is 2 blocks away & Mother's is around the corner!). The front desk was super helpful regarding advice about transportation to and from the Jazz Fest, local sites and restaurants, taking the St. Charles Streetcar, etc. The room was not impeccably clean to begin with (big stains on the carpet, marks on the walls), but our room was cleaned daily, sheets changed quickly and efficiently. The daily continental breakfast was ok (you'll venture out for your own New Orleans breakfast ...

This hotel was pretty great. They had great valet service, which I recommend in a party city such as NOLA; the front desk staff were exceptional and could tell you just about all you needed to know about where to go and how to find it. I booked a King bed and got upgraded to a double in one of the largest rooms in the hotel upon arrival. The room was clean, beautiful and quiet. I would definitely come back to stay in this hotel or reserve rooms for those who come to visit me in NOLA. It is in a central part of downtown, you can walk to a number of fabulous places, take the ferry to Algiers or if you want, you can hop in the car and the interstate is very near.

Experienced a GREAT stay during St. Patrick's Day weekend. Everything worked out really well. Our room was very clean, staff was super friendly and willing to accommodate us in any way possible -- even switching rooms if we so chose to, although we didn't, it was courteous that they would offer. Valet: Definitely Worth It. $28/day which is pretty fair for the area and convenient. Down the street and behind the building itself, there are parking lots which run $26-$30/day; so $28 is fair. Took about 15-20 minutes to get our car back. Breakfast: Just a typical breakfast, I think the only thing served Warm are the pancakes. But it's Free...so not worth complaining too much. Room: Very quiet....
